headlines.text: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control. In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.
Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most. The most revealing thing about the summit in Washington may be what the two leaders did not say - and what we still don't know.
Mexico's Pacific coast braces for Hurricane Polo. The category-four storm is approaching the state of Baja California Sur, on Mexico's northern Pacific coast.
Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 28 dead. The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.
Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections. Aleksandar Vučić's administration has been dogged by prolonged protests over allegations of corruption.
One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey. Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.

Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow. A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.
Pope says 'scourge' of abuse must be rooted out as he visits Lourdes. Pope Leo spoke to bishops before leading a service attended by thousands of worshippers in France.
Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group. Rescuers are looking for at least 10 Nepalese people who were preparing to take climbers up the Himlung Himal peak.
Switzerland rejects stricter interpretation of its neutrality. The initiative would have prevented the nation from imposing sanctions unless approved by the UN.

Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too. Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.
Woman charged with stealing from patients and staff at hospitals across Ontario. The 34-year-old is under investigation for incidents that began in February 2024 up until as recently as last month.
Indian university suspends classes amid violent protests over alleged rape. Lovely University suspends classes for 10 days due to campus unrest over rape allegations denied by officials.
Israeli football fans chant military slogans after defeat to Ireland. Israeli football fans chant military slogans after defeat to Ireland
Ethiopia accuses Sudan, Egypt of backing Tigray rebels as fighting rages. Sudan army denies backing Tigray fighters, says rival paramilitary RSF receiving support from within Ethiopia.
Palestinians denounce Israeli minister Ben-Gvir’s threats against prisoner. Footage of national security minister taunting Hassan Salama in his cell draws sharp condemnation from Palestinians.
Al Jazeera reports from near front line in Ethiopia’s Afar region. Al Jazeera reports from Ethiopia’s Afar region, where fighting has spread amid efforts to oust PM Abiy Ahmed.
Oil prices surge after Trump rejects Iran’s plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude rises more than 3 percent to top $107 a barrel as Washington dismisses Tehran's proposal to end war.
Azeez Al-Shaair honours slain Palestinian sisters despite NFL sanctions. The Houston Texans linebacker wore eye black with the names of slain sisters Lana, 12, and Bana, eight.
Mapping Israel’s 300 checkpoints: Where they are and how they work. Israel has shut occupied West Bank crossings for a week, further restricting Palestinian movement and holy site access.
Police probe ‘terror’ incident near RAF base used in Iran war: What we know. Five men were arrested on suspicion of the 'preparation of a terrorist act' near RAF Fairford, a base used by the US.
Iran’s children return to school under the shadow of war. Iranian children have missed schooling due to the US war.
France’s far-right National Rally gains ground in Senate vote. The vote marks the first time the far-right party gained enough seats to form its own caucus.
Belgium vs France – Nations League: Team line-ups, head-to-head, Mbappe. Two-time world champions France travel to Belgium for Monday's Nations League clash without captain Kylian Mbappe.
Rescuers search for 12 missing after Nepal avalanche kills two. Rescue teams resume search for missing people after avalanche on Himlung Himal killed two people during severe weather.
US, China list goods recommended for tariff cuts following Trump-Xi summit. Washington and Beijing announce details of agreement to reduce tariffs on $60bn of trade.
Serbia’s snap election: Can Vucic outmanoeuvre the student revolt?. The country's early parliamentary elections won’t end its crisis or defuse Vucic’s troubles, analysts say.

Madonna dominates VMAs with Artist of the Year win after showstopping opening performance. Madonna commanded attention at the MTV VMAs, winning seven awards and opening the show with star-studded performance.

Denver Broncos storm back from down 16-0 at halftime to beat Los Angeles Rams in instant classic. Bo Nix accounted for three second-half touchdowns as the Denver Broncos erased a 16-0 deficit against the Los Angeles Rams in a wild comeback.

Texas man arrested after 'intentionally' crashing into a closed Kroger to use bathroom: cops. A 60-year-old Texas man crashed his vehicle into a closed Kroger because he needed to use the bathroom and now faces criminal mischief charges.

Benjamin Satterley, pro wrestling star known as Pac, dead at 40. Benjamin Satterley, known as Pac, challenged for the AEW National Championship at All Out just one day before his death was announced at age 40.

Attorney for lone holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy mistrial pushes back on claims of refusing the law. Lindsay Clancy's holdout juror had "zero doubt" about his position, his attorney tells Kayleigh McEnany, citing "a mountain of evidence" for conviction.

Houston Astros secure the most embarrassing kind of Major League Baseball history with AL West win. The Houston Astros clinched the AL West at 81-81, becoming the worst division-winning team in Major League Baseball history over a full season.

Foiled terror plot at bomber base signals wider threat to US military installations: expert. Five men arrested near RAF Fairford may have planned a complex, coordinated VBIED attack on U.S. strategic bombers, a former intelligence official says.

Angels reach historic 100-loss low with season-closing defeat against Mariners as new era looms. Mike Trout watched from the dugout as the Los Angeles Angels fell 7-3 to the Mariners, crossing the 100-loss mark for the first time in 65 years.

Trevor Lawrence fantasy owners are beside themselves after inexplicable decision in fourth quarter blowout. Trevor Lawrence's baffling slide at the one-yard line in the Jacksonville Jaguars' 35-6 rout of the Patriots sent fantasy football owners reeling.

Kathy Griffin says Ed Sheeran should have told Robert Kraft to 'go f--- yourself' over Macklemore. Kathy Griffin said Ed Sheeran should have told Robert Kraft to back off after Macklemore was barred from Gillette Stadium over his "Free Palestine" chants.

Baker Mayfield leaves game after writhing in pain on turf in Tampa Bay when thumb on throwing hand injured. Baker Mayfield left screaming in pain after his thumb bent gruesomely on a fourth-down interception, sending him to the locker room for X-rays.

Team USA captain thanks Trump after massive Presidents Cup comeback: ‘He gets all the credit’. Trump told captain Brandt Snedeker he'd bring energy to the Presidents Cup, and the U.S. rallied from a three-point deficit in Sunday singles.

Police hunt sexually violent predator who vanished after GPS 'tamper mode' alert. Merle Wakefield had been on conditional release since November 2024 with GPS monitoring. Now the convicted sex offender is missing in San Diego County.

Deshaun Watson goes from Cleveland villain to hero in Browns upset win, as home crowd turns jeers to cheers. Deshaun Watson turned Cleveland's Dawg Pound boos into "Let's go Watson" chants with a fourth-quarter comeback against the Carolina Panthers.

Caitlin Clark, Fever get absolute reality check in Game 1 playoff beatdown against Aces. A'ja Wilson's 38-point, 16-rebound masterclass powered the Las Vegas Aces to a dominant 102-85 Game 1 rout over the Indiana Fever in playoffs.

What to know about the $810 million in spending canceled by President Trump. President Trump announced plans to cancel $810 million in Congressionally approved spending, a move that some in his own party are calling illegal.

How to limit the rat numbers? Train the humans. D.C.'s Rat Rangers take anyone who is interested on night time safaris through some of the Capitol's filthiest back alleys to learn the way of the rats, and to be better humans.

5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety. Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.

Welcome to the 'Wild West' of AI in schools: Research is scarce, but experiments abound. Teachers are using AI to develop lesson plans, and in some districts, AI chatbots give students feedback on their work. Meanwhile, the research around how AI can help students is extremely limited.

Morning news brief. President Trump has rejected Iran's latest proposal to end the war, five men were arrested near a U.K. air base for an alleged terror plot, Trump's fight with the press leaves his events uncovered.

Mexico's Baja California braces for Hurricane Polo as Hurricane Nolo threatens Hawaii. Hurricane Nolo edged further away from the Hawaiian Islands on Sunday as major Hurricane Polo bore down on Mexico's Baja California peninsula with a threat of storm surge, high winds and heavy rains.

Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis. Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.
Nantucket shipwreck uncovered by Nor'easter. The local newspaper in Nantucket got a tip: 'I found what I believe to be a shipwreck uncovered by the storm.'
Scientists discover two new species of sea spiders along Canadian coastline. So far, scientists have identified more than 1,300 species of sea spiders.
South Africa reels from spate of mass shootings that killed 38 people in a week. On Saturday night, there were separate mass shootings near South Africa's two largest cities.
